text: Spider-Man locomotion: swing between skyscrapers using both controllers as arms
description: No automatic flight; movement only from controller input. Each controller shoots a web or grapple at a building and hangs from it like a pendulum, while arm pulls add momentum. Release to fly ballistically, then grab the next roof. The city is procedural skyscraper blocks (grid ID, Gaussian height falloff around the player), so there are always anchors nearby.

status.comment: Implemented on branch experiments (0903daa, f3fb848): switch `swing` + fader `reel` in the motion tab. Trigger = rope of the grab distance, reels in, gravity, one-sided rope constraint per hand, release = ballistic flight; arm pulls (hand moving away from the anchor, relative to the head) shorten the rope 2x and pull you in. Verified by unit tests (pendulum through the bottom at ~14 m/s, arm-pull sign) and the app running in dev.sh. Human step: feel test in a headset — turn on `swing`, set `drag` to ~0.2, try reel 0..4; tell me whether swinging should replace zipping as the default, and whether ARM=2 feels right.
